title: 第5章 九天御龙诀第6章 今日之辱他日偿还
lines: “家主？”
叶家众高层全部起身，惊悚看着这一幕。
生死一念间，无人能瞬间闯入战场，阻挡叶寒的出手。
最主要是所有人都意想不到，一个叶家刚被废掉身份的世子，怎能和堂堂家主一战，能将家主逼迫到这种地步？
叶阳甫，这几十年都修炼到狗身上了不成？
“你放肆！”
叶阳甫肺都要气炸了。
他眼中的一个野种，当众踩在自己头上，将自己父女二人当做了垫脚石，这一切简直如同梦幻一样不真切。
一拳砸在叶阳甫的气海中央，狂猛的力量贯穿身躯，透入体内，叶阳甫再也无法坚持，直接被砸飞数十米开外，无力地趴在地上。
他的面容苍白，毫无血色，如同得了不治之症，下一刻就要死绝。
嘴角鲜血无法压抑，浑身在抽搐，上半身的衣衫炸碎，露出残破的血肉肌肤，只看到气海之外出现一道黑色拳印，有汩汩的血水不断渗出。
不久前还意气风发的叶阳甫，此刻宛若一尊垂髫入土的老人，只吊着最后一口气。
“我是你的义父！”
叶阳甫神使鬼差地说出这一句：“你敢杀我不成？”
“哈哈哈，义父？”
“我叶寒在寒渊矿区苦苦磨砺，侥幸拥有了天蛟战骨，亦得到三枚天级丹药沧澜丹，自己不舍得用，带回来给叶芷萱一枚，剩下两枚要留给你和老师。”
“可你们父女二人却直接翻脸，一不做二不休，当场将我废掉，打碎我的气海，挖走我的战骨，今日又当众宣判，要将我贬为奴仆？”
叶寒声音洪亮，震动天地：“你以为我会隐忍，你以为会将我彻底拿捏，天无绝人之路，我叶寒破而后立，逆境突破，挖骨之痛，气海被破之恨，我与叶家情分已尽。”
“杀你，太便宜了，我亲手打破你的气海，让你变成废人，让你也体会体会那无边的痛苦。”
叶寒说到这里之时已经出现在叶阳甫的三米之外，右拳抬起，再度锁定叶阳甫。
“叶寒，你敢动我父亲，我和你不死不休。”叶芷萱声音凄厉。
拳芒落下，大力贯穿。
全场寂静了下来，时间停止了流逝。
众人亲眼目睹叶家家主叶阳甫气海爆炸，元力流逝，武道修为彻底废掉。
武者往往面临生死，徘徊险境，但实则类似叶阳甫这样的人，平日里盘踞炎城内部，养尊处优，只要不是前去寒渊矿区那种险境，不主动求死，安稳一生是很正常的，不至于就此没落。
可今日当着炎城诸多大人物的面，他被昔日义子叶寒亲手打废。
“咎由自取！”
城主府大管家李悬终于忍不住开口，幸灾乐祸：“早就听闻这叶寒虽是捡来的义子，可对叶家忠心耿耿，尊长敬老，不至于突然性情大变，多半是所说没错，叶家父女逼他无路可走，只能出手。”
“不错，这叶阳甫简直就是白痴，叶寒能击败拥有天蛟战骨的叶芷萱，更与聚元九重的高手交手，简直是真正的天才，成为炎阳书院内门弟子都不是问题，这样的人物竟然被叶阳甫针对？”朱家家主朱文光语气讥讽。
content_en:
"Master?"
All the senior members of the Ye family stood up and watched this scene in horror.
In the moment of life and death, no one could break into the battlefield instantly and stop Ye Han's attack.
The most important thing is that no one expected that the heir apparent of the Ye family who had just been deposed could fight against the head of the family and force the head of the family to such an extent.
Ye Yangfu, have you been able to cultivate like a dog over the past few decades?
"You are presumptuous!"
Ye Yangfu's lungs were about to burst with anger.
In his eyes, a bastard stepped on his head in public and used his father and daughter as stepping stones. All of this was as unreal as a dream.
Bang! ! !
A punch hit the center of Ye Yangfu's Qi sea, and the fierce force penetrated his body and penetrated into his body. Ye Yangfu could no longer hold on, and was directly thrown dozens of meters away, lying on the ground helplessly.
His face was pale and bloodless, as if he had an incurable disease and was about to die in the next moment.
The blood at the corner of his mouth could not be suppressed, and his whole body was twitching. The clothes on his upper body were blown to pieces, revealing the broken flesh and blood. Only a black fist mark appeared outside the sea of ​​​​qi, and gurgling blood continued to seep out.
Ye Yangfu, who was so high-spirited not long ago, is now like an old man lying in the grave, hanging on to his last breath.
"I am your adoptive father!"
Ye Yangfu said this sentence in a strange way: "Do you dare to kill me?"
"Hahaha, adoptive father?"
"I, Ye Han, worked hard in the Hanyuan Mining Area. I was lucky enough to have the Heavenly Dragon Battle Bones. I also got three heaven-level elixirs, Canglan Dan. I was reluctant to use them, so I brought one back to Ye Zhixuan. The remaining two will be left to you and the teacher."
"But you two, father and daughter, turned against each other and refused to do anything else. You destroyed me on the spot, shattered my Qihai, dug away my bones, and today you pronounced the sentence in public, intending to demote me into a slave?"
Ye Han's voice was loud and loud, shaking the world: "You thought I would be forbearing, you thought you would completely control me, there is no road ahead, I, Ye Han, will stand up after breaking through, the adversity will break through, the pain of bone digging, the hatred of having my Qi sea broken, my relationship with the Ye family is over."
"Killing you is too cheap. I will break your Qihai with my own hands, turn you into a useless person, and let you experience the boundless pain."
When Ye Han said this, he had already appeared three meters away from Ye Yangfu. He raised his right fist and locked onto Ye Yangfu again.
"Ye Han, if you dare to touch my father, we will fight to the death." Ye Zhixuan's voice was stern.
Bang! ! !
The fist light fell and penetrated with great force.
The whole place fell silent, and time stopped passing.
Everyone witnessed with their own eyes that the head of the Ye family, Ye Yangfu, exploded in his sea of ​​qi, drained his energy, and completely destroyed his martial arts cultivation.
Warriors often face life and death and wander in dangerous situations, but in fact, people like Ye Yangfu usually stay inside Yancheng and enjoy themselves. As long as they are not in dangerous situations like going to the Hanyuan Mining Area and do not actively seek death, it is normal for them to live a stable life and not fall into decline.
But today, in front of many important people in Yancheng, he was defeated by his former adopted son Ye Han himself.
"It's your own fault!"
Li Xuan, the chief steward of the City Lord's Mansion, finally couldn't help but speak and gloated: "I have long heard that although Ye Han is an adopted son, he is loyal to the Ye family and respects his elders, so his temperament will not suddenly change. It is probably true that what he said is true. The Ye family and his daughter have forced him to have no choice but to take action."
"Yes, this Ye Yangfu is simply an idiot. Ye Han can defeat Ye Zhixuan, who possesses the Heavenly Dragon Battle Bones, and even fights against masters of the ninth level of Juyuan. He is simply a true genius. Becoming an inner disciple of Yanyang Academy is not a problem, but such a person is actually targeted by Ye Yangfu?" Zhu Wenguang, the head of the Zhu family, said in a sarcastic tone.
title_en: Chapter 5 Nine Heavens Controlling the Dragon Chapter 6 Today’s humiliation will be repaid tomorrow.
